_comment: Canonical authored record of the 18 anchor-set prompts (6 each at n=2/3/4). Subjects and attributes reuse the validated vocabulary from pi_level_experiment/generate_chains.py's MECHANISM_PROMPTS so token lookup, phrasing, and detectability stay in the regime already exercised there. Each prompt uses DISTINCT subjects and DISTINCT attributes. generate_anchor_images.py embeds an identical ANCHOR_PROMPTS literal (self-contained for the single-file Kaggle kernel); downstream stages read the self-describing manifest.json, not this file, so this file is the human-facing source of truth, not a runtime dependency. The prompt's intended pairing is NOT ground truth -- the human label on the rendered pixels is.
